name: zinterp_global_context_hooks
description: zInterp global context dispatch hooks handle WeaponSetMaxTetherAltitude, increment parse errors through the post-dispatch hook, and use the shared no-op deferred hook.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The deferred hook slot reuses WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownloadEventSink::CallbackNoOp, whose own functional target documents the shared no-op body at 0x414b50.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x414ad0 validates the leading-W fast path, exact strcmp against "WeaponSetMaxTetherAltitude", ParseFloatToken, zWeapon::SetMaxTetherAltitude, return 0 for handled and return 1 for pass-through.
Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c2090 validates IncErrorCount followed by return 1, with the command token ignored.
BN data for g_zInterp_GlobalContext_VTable maps slot 0 to 0x414ad0, slot 1 to 0x4c2090, and slot 2 to the already-reconstructed shared no-op at 0x414b50.

Native smoke calls the recovered table slots, verifies altitude mutation and token consumption for WeaponSetMaxTetherAltitude, verifies pass-through for another command, verifies error-count increment, and verifies the deferred hook returns zero without changing error count.
